rationale: C24 plausibly supplied a reusable structural template: it identifies newly relevant statutory authority, evaluates whether fully invoking that authority is appropriate in light of defense requirements and economic conditions, declines the broader course, directs a narrower administrative program, and requires close interagency coordination. The child follows a materially similar sequence for housing credit—considering a statutory increase, rejecting the full amount because defense demand for scarce materials would intensify inflation, authorizing only part, prescribing administrative restraints, and coordinating affected agencies. C21 and C23 share pieces of the defense-oriented interagency machinery but provide less complete parallels.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I do not believe that it would be in the public interest to authorize the full increase of $1,250 million... Accordingly... I hereby approve an increase of $650 million
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I do not consider it appropriate to invoke the authority contained in section 18(h) at this time. Instead, I am asking you to proceed immediately to develop a voluntary allocations program
shared_material.explanation: Both assess a newly available statutory mechanism, decline its fuller use, and substitute a narrower administrative response.

shared_material.child_excerpt: many materials used in residential and other construction will be required in increasing amounts for national defense purposes... [requiring] positive actions
shared_material.parent_excerpt: covering the requirements of the Armed Forces for steel mill products and steel contained in manufactured products
shared_material.explanation: Both justify intervention by defense-related pressure on essential materials and adapt economic controls to protect military supply.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I would appreciate it, therefore, if you will consult with the Veterans' Administrator in working out the details... [and] working closely with the Administrator of the Housing and Home Finance Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It will be necessary... for your office to work in the closest possible cooperation with the National Military Establishment in the preparation and execution of this program
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude with explicit interagency coordination requirements for planning and executing the directed measures.
